title: The Broken Sigil
author: Freya Lockridge
blurb: Juniper Whitlock, a debt-bound temple scribe, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the long winter finishes falling.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
